summary: [FE API 05.01] [ADDED] Reception Full Verified Patient Registration — POST /api/v1/patients/full
description:
h1. Phase 5 Patient Identity Closure — Reception Full Verified Patient Registration

*Contract ID:* N01
*HTTP Endpoint:* {{POST /api/v1/patients/full}}
*Actor and proof:* Reception + Patients.RegisterFull + current Practice assignment
*Backend:* Implemented; this Card is for UI integration, not a new backend mutation.

h2. UI Journey / ID producer-consumer

Reception patient Search/Registration-Matches → verify identity in-person → full multipart registration → returned global patientId → reservation.

h2. Exact backend request/response from source

h3. N01 — POST {{/api/v1/patients/full}}

Authorization: Patients.RegisterFull + active Reception assignment. Input (multipart): Basic identity/contact fields plus REQUIRED email,verifiedInPerson=true,identityVerificationBasis=GovernmentIdSeen|ApprovedAlternateEvidence; optional verificationNote<=500. Soft matches require matchReviewOutcome=DistinctPerson,matchReviewReason<=500. No password fields.

Success *201*: {{{patientId,applicationUserId,profileType:"Full",accountStatus:"PendingActivation",activationEmailMasked,invitationExpiresOnUtc}}}.

{code:bash}curl -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/patients/full" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" -F "doctorPracticeId=$PRACTICE" -F "nameAr=مريض تجريبي" -F "dateOfBirth=1990-02-03" -F "gender=Male" -F "phoneNumber=01000000000" -F "email=adult@example.test" -F "verifiedInPerson=true" -F "identityVerificationBasis=GovernmentIdSeen"{code}

h2. Frontend acceptance and security

* Match exact content type (multipart vs JSON), required fields, nullable fields and response IDs from source; map status codes from stable ProblemDetails errors.
* Mutations use documented fresh Idempotency-Key; identical retried request uses same key. Do not reuse key for changed payload. Honor RowVersion/proof when required.
* Current email proof/claim token is not interchangeable with account identity; no PatientId guessing, no arbitrary clinical access from family/contact.
* Handle loading, 401/403/404/409/422/429, form-level localized validation, retry and expiry; don't log passwords, OTPs, invitation/proof keys or private evidence.
* Refresh resolved Patient/Claim and allow only server-permitted next action after success.

*Linked end-to-end Feature Story:* https://loaisabir.atlassian.net/browse/WAS-565
*Canonical API Changes:* https://github.com/LoaiSaberC4r/Wasla/blob/main/PHASE-5-FINAL-API-CHANGES.md
*Security matrix:* https://github.com/LoaiSaberC4r/Wasla/blob/main/PHASE-5-FINAL-SECURITY-MATRIX.md

summary: [FE API 05.11] [ADDED] SuperAdmin Patient Claims List — GET /api/v1/admin/patient-claims
description:
h1. Phase 5 Final Patient Identity — SuperAdmin Patient Claims List

*Original backend contract:* N11
*Exact endpoint:* {{GET /api/v1/admin/patient-claims}}
*Actor + permission:* SuperAdmin / PatientClaims.ViewAll
*Implementation:* Backend present in Wasla main; this Jira ticket tracks UI integration and verification, not backend coding.

h2. Screen-by-screen UI path

Admin Patient Claims → filtered/paginated pending claims list → select returned Claim ID.
*API ID producer:* Source patient-claims/duplicates list and details, or current claim status; always use the returned IDs and version.
*Linked feature scenario:* [FE FEATURE 03 — Patient Self-Onboarding, Claim & Reception Identity Reuse|https://loaisabir.atlassian.net/browse/WAS-565].

h2. Canonical request, response and sample

h3. N11 — GET {{/api/v1/admin/patient-claims}}

Authorization: SuperAdmin + PatientClaims.ViewAll (live DB). Input (query): status?,fromUtc?,toUtc?,emailSearch? exact normalized; pageNumber=1,pageSize=20 max100.

Success *200*: {{{items:[{id,status,claimantEmailMasked,submittedOnUtc,lastActivityOnUtc,evidenceCount,rowVersion}],totalCount,pageNumber,pageSize}}}.

{code:bash}curl -X GET "$BASE/api/v1/admin/patient-claims?status=PendingReview&pageNumber=1&pageSize=20" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN"{code}

h2. Business & authorization

* Platform-global Patient identity is separate from ApplicationUser; claim/review must not silently create or overwrite another patient or grant medical entitlement.
* Live SuperAdmin status + exact granular permission checked server side. Claims and identity evidence are private and must not be exposed as unsigned/public URLs.
* Use server-defined state, capabilities and version; do not invent any new claim state, field, or action.
* Read latest RowVersion before mutation. Send Idempotency-Key wherever authoritative contract requires; retry only identical payload/key. Concurrency 409 requires refresh and deliberate resubmission.

h2. Frontend acceptance criteria

* Typed API request, exact method/path/query/body/content-type and source DTO/status.
* List/filter/detail/evidence/decision/history/navigation supports loading, empty, success and accessible ar/en copy.
* Review decisions guarded by actor permission and current available action; success refreshes claim/duplicate history and action availability.
* Correct 401/403/404, validation 422, version conflict 409, rate/temporary 429/503 UX with stable localized ProblemDetails codes.
* No patient IDs guessed or leaked; no document body, OTP, contact proof or credentials in logs.
